city_106.city_intro: Born in Dubai. Still obsessed with it. Looking for the best burger in Dubai? There are seven Pickls across the city, from the sand at JBR to Mirdif City Centre, and three of them never close.

city_sections.field_pickl_city_section_body: JLT, City Walk and Motor City never close. JBR runs till 4am, and Madinat Badr till 2am at the weekend. Sleep is overrated. (It isn't. Get some. After the burger.)

city_sections.field_pickl_city_section_heading: Best Burger in Dubai. Officially. Twice.
city_sections.field_pickl_city_section_body: Time Out Dubai gave us Best Burger in Dubai in 2022. Then they did it again in 2023. We'd bring it up less if it wasn't true. The full story's here.

Grain-fed beef, smashed on a hot grill. Chicken breast hand-breaded and fried when you order, not a minute before. Sauces, spice blends and pickles made fresh every day, under one roof. No hormones, no preservatives, no additives. What you see is what you get.

The Original. Double patty, cheese, dill pickles, white onion, mustard, ketchup, potato bun. Nothing to hide behind. Rather design your own? Build Your Own comes single or double, and in a plant-based version too.

Chicken person? The Chicken Sando comes in five heat levels, from plain to the reaper. Medium-ish is a warm hug. The reaper comes with a waiver. We're not joking.

Finish with a shake, made Gooder. Full menu.

More Pickls down the coast in Abu Dhabi and up the road in Sharjah.

city_faqs.field_pickl_city_faq_a: Yep, on Talabat, Careem, Noon Food, Deliveroo and Keeta. Pick your app, pick your burger.
Deliveroo Restaurant of the Year, four years running, 2022 to 2025. Best Homegrown in 2025. Best Fried Chicken, once.
Double chuck patty, cheese, tomato, lettuce and secret sauce. Potato bun, naturally.
There is. Rewards, the menu and a store finder, all in your pocket.

city_108.city_intro: Three Pickls in the capital, three very different backdrops. Looking for the best burger in Abu Dhabi? It's the same one at all three. You just pick the view. Also in the emirate: Pickl Al Ain, on Plot 10 in Zakhir. The only Pickl in Al Ain, open till 2am.

city_sections.field_pickl_city_section_heading: Midnight is just the halfway mark
city_sections.field_pickl_city_section_body: Mamsha wraps up at midnight. Khalifa City carries on till 4am, every night of the week. Your 2am self will be thrilled. Your 9am self might have notes.

city_sections.field_pickl_city_section_heading: The trophies stayed in Dubai. The recipe didn't.
city_sections.field_pickl_city_section_body: Time Out Dubai named Pickl Best Burger in Dubai in 2022, then again in 2023. Dubai awards, won in Dubai. What came down the coast is the way the food gets made.

Grain-fed beef, smashed and laid on a potato bun. Chicken breast hand-breaded and fried to order. Sauces, spice blends and pickles made fresh every day. No hormones, no preservatives, no additives in the beef or the chicken.

The Original goes first. After that, climb the Chicken Sando's five heat levels, from plain to the reaper, and stop when your eyes start watering.

Vegetarians get plant-based versions of the cheeseburgers, and there's Build Your Own too. The Famous Ice Cream Sando is ice cream stuffed in a deep-fried cinnamon sugar bun, so plan your stomach space accordingly. Full menu.

More Pickls up the coast in Dubai and Sharjah.

city_faqs.field_pickl_city_faq_q: Does Pickl deliver in Abu Dhabi?
city_faqs.field_pickl_city_faq_a: Yep. Talabat, Careem, Noon Food, Deliveroo and Keeta, from all three city Pickls and from Al Ain.

city_faqs.field_pickl_city_faq_q: Which Abu Dhabi Pickl is easiest to park at?
city_faqs.field_pickl_city_faq_a: Corniche: the WTC Mall car park is ticketless and Salik does the billing. Khalifa City: Gardens Plaza has parking for diners.

city_faqs.field_pickl_city_faq_q: Is there a Pickl drive-thru near Abu Dhabi?
city_faqs.field_pickl_city_faq_a: Head inland. Pickl Al Ain opened as a drive-thru at Zakher Drive Thru Park in June 2023.
Close. Homegrown in Dubai, just up the coast.

city_107.city_intro: The E11 used to be the only road from Sharjah to a Pickl. Not anymore. There are two Pickls inside the emirate now, one on East Boulevard in Aljada and one on Al Heera Beach, so chasing the best burger in Sharjah no longer comes with a traffic jam.

city_sections.field_pickl_city_section_heading: The E11 was getting a bit much.
city_sections.field_pickl_city_section_body: Plenty of you drove into Dubai for a cheeseburger. We took that as a compliment, and as a hint. Around New Year 2023 the first Sharjah Pickl opened on Al Heera Beach. Aljada makes two.

The trophies come from next door: Time Out Dubai named Pickl Best Burger in Dubai in 2022 and 2023. Sharjah gets the exact same burger.

The cooking travels fine. Grain-fed beef, smashed on a hot grill. Chicken breast breaded by hand and fried when you order. Sauces, spice blends and pickles made fresh every day, on the beach and on the boulevard alike.

city_sections.field_pickl_city_section_heading: New here? Order The Jeff burger.
city_sections.field_pickl_city_section_body: Or The BBQ Bacon Burger. Add a Tub O' House Pickles in dill, onion or chilli, then a salted caramel shake to close it out. Vegetarians get plant-based versions of most of the cheeseburgers, Build Your Own included, and little legends get Little Pickl meals. Everything else is on the menu.
Pickl is in Dubai and Abu Dhabi too. Head up the coast and Lagoon Stop in Ras Al Khaimah is a drive-thru, so you don't even have to get out of the car.

city_faqs.field_pickl_city_faq_q: Can I get Pickl delivered in Sharjah?
city_faqs.field_pickl_city_faq_a: Both Sharjah Pickls are on Talabat, Careem, Noon Food, Deliveroo and Keeta. Still no E11 involved.
Comeback, secret, ranch, BBQ, Caesar, mustard or buffalo. Found the one? Go Big Boy.
The Rocket Parma Salad. Rocket, white onion, parmesan, balsamic. Virtuous, briefly.
